name: Infoblox — Device Joined Network Without a Hostname
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DHCP"
| alter mac = lowercase(arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "([0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})"), 0)),
        ip  = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "(?:DHCPACK|DHCPOFFER) on (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0),
        hostname = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "\((\S+?)\) via"), 0),
        relay = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, " via (\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0)
| filter mac != null and ip != null
| filter xdm.event.description contains "DHCPACK" and hostname = null and not (mac ~= "^.[26ae]:")
| comp values(ip) as ip_list, values(relay) as relays, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by mac
| fields mac, ip_list, relays, first_seen, last_seen
description: A device with a burned-in MAC was leased an address without presenting a hostname: an unmanaged or unenrolled device joined the network. Managed hosts always send one.
alert_name: Infoblox — Device Joined Network Without a Hostname
alert_description:
What fired: A device with a burned-in MAC was leased an address without presenting a hostname: an unmanaged or unenrolled device joined the network. Managed hosts always send one.

Why it matters: an unmanaged, spoofed or rogue device may be on the network. Assessed severity: Low.

Investigate:
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity ($mac) to related activity in the same window.
  - Check the asset inventory / owner for the device or user involved.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized before escalating.
